== Notes ==
* The caster must have at least 2 [[health]] in order to successfully resurrect the target.
* The health loss occurs before the resurrection.

== Trivia ==
* The skill's name references a quote from [[w:Adam|Adam]] in [[w:Book of Genesis|Genesis]] [http://bible.cc/genesis/2-23.htm 2:23], which reads "''And the man said, “ this is now bone of my bones, and '''flesh of my flesh''': she shall be called ‘Woman,’ because she was taken out of ‘Man.’”"''
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
